title: Video-LLaMA: An Instruction-Tuned Audio-Visual Language Model for Video Understanding
description: Extends LLaVA's visual instruction tuning to video and audio. Adds a Video Q-Former (sampling frames from video) and an Audio Q-Former (encoding audio from IMAGEBIND) into the Llama language model. Enables video QA, audio QA, and audio-visual QA with a single model. First open-source audio-visual LLM.
authors: Zhang, Zhang, Li, Qiao, Gao, Xu, Shi, Shan, Qing, Zhu (Alibaba DAMO / NTU)
